records.response_truth: Is that..are they actually responding? Someone grab the radio, go go go!

records.utterance: I dreamed about home last night.

records.response_truth: Look, I believe you. And if it had come to that, maybe it would've mattered. But we talked about this - the bottle, the crackers. You said you'd keep us in the loop. We're three hours from rescue and you're still doing it. That's the bit I can't quite get past.
records.response_pred: Alright, keep it that way if you need to. Just make sure it's for emergencies only.

records.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?
records.response_truth:
Honestly? I'd have trusted people sooner. Like, we wasted time dancing around stuff - the hidden food, the notebook, DaVinci's swim plan. If we'd just been straight with each other from day one we probably could've got here with a lot less friction. And I'd have checked in on Michelangelo more, properly. Not just "you alright?" and moving on.

What would you change?
records.response_pred: Yeah, that's pretty thorough. If I had to do it over? Honestly, I'd probably just stay calm and keep everyone together more. Sometimes the little things can make a big difference. You doing this report is good though, gives us something tangible to look back on.

records.response_pred: Alright, take your time with that. We could use a clear plan moving forward. Let's make sure to cover everything — food, water, shelter, and any other resources. That'll give us a good base to work from.

records.utterance: Those flowers DaVinci drew on the beach… I never really understood what they were for. What practical purpose did they serve out here?
